title: Billy Berg's club and who played there
summary: Morgenstern mentions Dickenson's band at Billy Berg's in Los Angeles, where Hawkins, Dizzy and Charlie played.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: For instance, your band at Billy Berg's in Los Angeles...
And that's a place that's become famous because Dizzy and Bird played there the first time they came...
Yeah, a lot of guys played there. Hawkins did. I don't know for sure that Louis didn't play there. I'm not sure.
With the big band, I guess, at that time.
Well, he didn't have to have too big a band. Too big a band on there... It wasn't a real big stand.
So it must have been the All-Stars on there.
Probably. I don't know for sure whether they played there or not. I don't know. I know Hawkins played there, and Dizzy, Charlie, and quite a few other guys.
